retreats.name: She Shines — women's yoga & breathwork retreat
retreats.desc: Tantra Hatha, Vinyasa and Yin yoga, breathwork, a gong bath, a coastal hike and women's circles by the beach. Max 20.

retreats.name: reTREAT Yourself Ibiza
retreats.desc: Body work, NLP and workshops to break limiting patterns, in a small group of women. Third edition.

retreats.name: Inner Harmony: Valley Spirit
retreats.desc: Qi Gong, Dao yoga, sauna and sea immersion, sound healing and a herbal workshop on a quiet agroturismo. Transfers included.

retreats.name: Reset in Ibiza
retreats.desc: Vinyasa, Yin and mobility, workouts, a cacao and sound ceremony, massages, a hike and a private chef.

retreats.name: 20-hour Asana Intensive
retreats.desc: A ten-day non-residential intensive for practitioners who want to go deeper. Early-bird €300.

retreats.name: Winter Paradise
retreats.venue: Boutique finca in a valley of almond and olive trees
retreats.desc: Feet in the earth, face in the sun, dancing round the fire. Morning yoga, a silent hike, Zumba and a chocolate-truffle walk; evenings with campfires, breathwork, a nature sauna and fire ceremony, and a closing Ibiza family-table dinner by a private chef. Max 10. Day rate without the stay €895.

retreats.name: Yoga, Pilates, Breathwork & Self-awareness
retreats.venue: Villa with infinity pool near Cala Tarida
retreats.desc: Daily yoga and Pilates, meditation, breathwork and self-inquiry, a Formentera day by boat and bike, and a cacao ceremony.

retreats.name: Sound Healing — Brahma Nada Yoga, Level 1
retreats.desc: Gong, voice, mantra and shamanic drum, with daily yoga and pranayama. Optional 50-hour certificate.

retreats.name: Return to the Mother
retreats.desc: A six-day retreat for mothers: body work, dance, circles, yoga nidra and sound, with a chef on site.

retreats.name: Conscious Walking — almond blossom & life coaching
retreats.desc: Guided walks through the almond blossom of Santa Agnès, Sant Mateu and Sant Joan, with daily life coaching. Max 12.

retreats.name: Winter Paradise — almond blossom edition
retreats.venue: Boutique finca in a valley of almond and olive trees
retreats.desc: The same week of yoga, hikes, campfires, breathwork and shared dinners — in the weeks the almond trees are in bloom. Max 10. Day rate without the stay €895.

retreats.name: Sound Healing — Brahma Nada Yoga, Level 2
retreats.desc: Advanced sound-healing facilitator training with daily yoga, steps from the beach.

retreats.name: She Shines Ibiza — Easter week
retreats.desc: Seven days of Tantra Hatha, Vinyasa and Yin, breathwork, sound baths, a hike and the beach. Vegetarian, max 20.

retreats.name: Conscious Vacation — life coaching, inspiration & joy
retreats.venue: Beachfront spa hotel near Ibiza Town
retreats.desc: Three hours of group coaching a day, afternoons on the beach. An eight-day version runs 27 Mar – 3 Apr.

organisers.name: Crystal Mountain Ibiza
organisers.desc: A crystal temple on a hillside in the north — some 80 tonnes of crystals in one space. Ceremonies, sound and meditation gatherings and private visits through the winter; programme announced on Instagram, visits by appointment.

organisers.name: Swan Retreats Ibiza
organisers.desc: Private and small-group retreats (Tree of Life, women's, couples) offered November to April on request.

organisers.name: La Casa Shambala
organisers.desc: 18-day 200h Hatha & Vinyasa teacher training, editions in November, January and February — exact dates on request.

organisers.name: Retreat Ibiza (Nathalie)
organisers.desc: Dutch-language retreats; a winter retreat 'for the dark days' is planned, dates to come.

organisers.name: Ibiza Wellness Retreats
organisers.desc: One-to-one wellness packages, bookable on request through the winter.
